1. (Currently Amended) A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member, and __a light dispersing optic element overlapping said diodes and positioned to preferentially direct light substantially perpendicular to an elongated axis of the columnar body__.

2. (Original) The lamp of claim 1 wherein a second end of said columnar body is open.

3. (Cancelled)

4. (Cancelled)

5. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein __the plurality of diodes are substantially evenly spaced radially around the columnar body and wherein each diode is spaced at substantially equal angular intervals__.

6. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 5 wherein said fins are substantially equally disposed between said diodes __such that each fin is positioned at a substantially equal angular distance from adjacent diodes__.

7. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body comprises one of a tetragon, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon, hendecagon, or dodecagon in cross-section __and wherein the columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK__.

8. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 7 wherein __exactly one diode resides on each face of said columnar body__.

9. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 8 wherein one fin resides on each corner of said columnar body __and wherein a single light dispersing optic element is disposed between each adjacent fin overlapping said diode on each face__.

10. (Cancelled)

11. (Original) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK.

12. (Cancelled)

13. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said base member comprises __an Edison screw base or a wedge base and wherein said base member is configured to provide electrical connection to standard AC power sources__.

14. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said electronics module comprises a printed circuit board including circuitry for converting AC to DC current __and wherein the electronics module is disposed in thermal communication with said columnar body to facilitate heat dissipation__.

15. (Cancelled)

16. (Currently Amended) A lamp comprising an elongated hollow polygonal body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, a fin extending radially from each corner of said body, __exactly one light emitting diode mounted to each side of said body__, a screw or wedge base connector closing a first end of said body, a second end of said body being open, an electronics module disposed within said body in electrical communication with said connector and said light emitting diodes, __a light dispersing optic element positioned between each adjacent fin and overlapping the diode on each side, said optic element preferentially directing light substantially perpendicular to an elongated axis of the columnar body,__ and said lamp having a general A19 outline.

17. (Currently Amended) A method of manufacturing a lamp comprising extruding an elongated hollow body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK, cutting said body to a predetermined length, __forming a plurality of integral radially extending fins on said body during or after extrusion__, attaching exactly one light emitting diode to each side of said body, __positioning a light dispersing optic element between each adjacent fin to overlap each diode,__ and providing electrical circuitry suitable for powering said light emitting diodes.

18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said material has a thermal conductivity greater than about 150 W/mK __and wherein the material is selected from aluminum or copper alloys__.

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said body includes a plurality of integral radially extending fins __formed during the extrusion process__.

20. (Cancelled)
